name: Date Augmenter API
description: Provides a plugin class for augmenting the display of dates and times.
project_description:
This module provides an API for modules to provide plugins that will add to or change the output of supported processors such as in Smart Date 3.4.x or newer. Currently available plugins for this API include:

 
 Add to Calendar Date Augmenter 
 Date Content Augmenter 
 Link Augmenter 
 AP Stylebook Date Augmenter 
 
 The central idea of this module is to allow a site builder to assemble the date formatting capabilities they require, instead of having to choose between individual formatters that may only satisfy part of their requirements.
